qb_accounts._comment: QuickBooks chart-of-accounts mapping for the monthly Stripe journal entry generated on the Revenue Recognition page. Mirrors Beau's existing entry (Aug 2026 screenshot). Edit labels here — no code change needed. `accrual_presentation`: 'append' keeps the cash lines exactly as Beau books them and ADDS the accrual (AR) adjustment lines; 'restate' replaces the 4000 cash figure with the recognized figure. `sales_tax_basis`: 'invoice' = tax on invoices billed in the month (consistent with accrual 4000); 'cash' = tax embedded in the month's deposits (Beau's historical 4050 basis). Books go-live is set in build_revenue_recognition.mjs (BOOKS_GO_LIVE) — Jan 2026 as of 2026-09-05.

notes: Recognized subscription revenue on the accrual/invoice basis with a month-end collection cutoff, parallel to the cash pipeline. Books go live 2026-01; 2026-01+ carries per-customer detail for manual QB true-up. 125 open/uncollectible invoices in AR aging. 2 orphan Stripe customers need roster mapping.
